description: crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/mdn_integration.rs:127-131: the oracle comment for the finalRecipient assertion says 'MemoryBackend always returns rfc822; test@example.com for test purposes' but does not cite where that value is defined (common/mod.rs:2361). If a future maintainer changes the hardcoded value in common/mod.rs, the test will fail with no clear pointer to the fix. Fix: add a comment '// defined in tests/common/mod.rs send_mdns step 4' or extract the constant so the test and fixture share a single source of truth.
title: Anchor finalRecipient test oracle to its definition site
